ex.en: The scientists noticed an anomaly in the data.
ex.zh: 科學家注意到資料中有異常。

ex.en: A cold day in July is an anomaly here.
ex.zh: 七月出現冷天在這裡很反常。

ex.en: The announcer read the news in a calm voice.
ex.zh: 播報員用平靜的語氣播報新聞。

ex.en: The stadium announcer called out the players' names.
ex.zh: 球場播報員唸出球員的名字。

ex.en: He made mistakes on purpose to annoy me.
ex.zh: 他故意犯錯來惹我生氣。

ex.en: Waiting for too long makes most people annoyed.
ex.zh: 等太久會讓大多數人不耐煩。

ex.en: Meg sometimes annoys Ken.
ex.zh: 梅格有時會惹肯生氣。

ex.en: The Nobel Prize is awarded annually on December 10, the day of Alfred Nobel's death.
ex.zh: 諾貝爾獎每年在十二月十日頒發，那天是諾貝爾的忌日。

ex.en: The conference is held annually in Taipei.
ex.zh: 這場研討會每年在台北舉辦。

ex.en: The company reviews salaries annually.
ex.zh: 公司每年檢討一次薪資。

ex.en: You can call me anytime you like.
ex.zh: 你隨時都可以打電話給我。

ex.en: You can borrow my car anytime.
ex.zh: 你隨時可以借用我的車。

ex.en: I can start anytime.
ex.zh: 我隨時可以開始。

anytime.zh: anytime soon：（多用於否定）短期內

ex.en: I don't think this rain will let up anytime soon.
ex.zh: 我看這場雨短時間內不會停。

ex.en: Prices won't come down anytime soon.
ex.zh: 價格短期內不會降下來。

ex.en: He has an eye for antiques.
ex.zh: 他很有鑑賞古董的眼光。

ex.en: This chair is a valuable antique.
ex.zh: 這張椅子是很值錢的古董。

ex.en: Can you tell me where the nearest antique shop is?
ex.zh: 可以告訴我最近的古董店在哪裡嗎？

ex.en: He came across this old coin in an antique shop.
ex.zh: 他在古董店偶然發現了這枚舊硬幣。

ex.en: She collects antique furniture.
ex.zh: 她收藏古董家具。

ex.en: After the fire, they had to start anew.
ex.zh: 火災之後，他們必須從頭開始。

ex.en: Let's begin anew tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我們明天重新開始吧。

ex.en: It's too late, anyhow.
ex.zh: 反正已經太晚了。

ex.en: It was raining, but we went out anyhow.
ex.zh: 雖然在下雨，我們還是出門了。

ex.en: Anyhow, let's get back to the main topic.
ex.zh: 總之，我們回到正題吧。

ex.en: I'm not anti the plan; I just have some concerns.
ex.zh: 我不是反對這個計畫，只是有些疑慮。

ex.en: Most of the team are anti working on weekends.
ex.zh: 大部分組員都反對週末上班。

ex.en: She receives an annuity of 20,000 dollars a year.
ex.zh: 她每年領兩萬美元的年金。

ex.en: He bought an annuity to plan for retirement.
ex.zh: 他買了年金保險為退休做準備。

ex.en: The purpose of antitrust law is to stop the abusive influence of the market by big companies.
ex.zh: 反壟斷法的目的，是防止大公司濫用對市場的影響力。

ex.en: The company is facing an antitrust investigation.
ex.zh: 這家公司正面臨反壟斷調查。

ex.en: The job requires strong analytical skills.
ex.zh: 這份工作需要很強的分析能力。

ex.en: Amy has a very analytical mind.
ex.zh: Amy 的思考非常有條理、善於分析。

ex.en: She has strong analytic skills.
ex.zh: 她的分析能力很強。

ex.en: We need a more analytic approach to the problem.
ex.zh: 我們需要用更有分析性的方法處理這個問題。

any.zh: 任何的、一些（用於疑問句、否定句）

ex.en: Do you have any idea when the bank closes?
ex.zh: 你知道銀行幾點關門嗎？

ex.en: Please inform me of any changes in the situation.
ex.zh: 情況如有任何變化，請通知我。

ex.en: She speaks English better than any of her classmates.
ex.zh: 她的英文說得比班上任何同學都好。

ex.en: If you need any, just ask me.
ex.zh: 如果你需要一些，跟我說就好。

ex.en: Mr Kato was too old to work any longer.
ex.zh: 加藤先生年紀太大，沒辦法再工作了。

ex.en: I can't put up with that noise any longer.
ex.zh: 我再也受不了那個噪音了。

ex.en: I hear he's just begun looking for another job.
ex.zh: 聽說他剛開始找另一份工作。

ex.en: Can we meet another day?
ex.zh: 我們可以改天見面嗎？

ex.en: I would like to have another cup of coffee.
ex.zh: 我想再來一杯咖啡。

ex.en: The boy reached out for another piece of cake.
ex.zh: 男孩伸手又拿了一塊蛋糕。

ex.en: I think we had better wait another thirty minutes.
ex.zh: 我想我們最好再等三十分鐘。

ex.en: I have a ball-point pen, but I want another.
ex.zh: 我有一支原子筆，但我還想再要一支。

ex.en: This cup is dirty. Can I have another?
ex.zh: 這個杯子髒了，可以再給我一個嗎？

ex.en: A tiger is a very ferocious kind of animal.
ex.zh: 老虎是一種非常兇猛的動物。

ex.en: Humans are the only animals that can use fire.
ex.zh: 人類是唯一會用火的動物。

ex.en: There are a lot of animals in the park.
ex.zh: 公園裡有好多動物。

ex.en: I don't have a CD player, but I bought the CD anyway.
ex.zh: 我沒有 CD 播放器，但還是把 CD 買了。

ex.en: Everyone was against it, but Mary and John got married anyway.
ex.zh: 雖然大家都反對，瑪麗和約翰還是結婚了。

ex.en: Anyway, you'll never know.
ex.zh: 反正你永遠不會知道。

ex.en: Anyway, let's get back to work.
ex.zh: 總之，我們回去工作吧。

ex.en: Who are you, anyway?
ex.zh: 你到底是誰？

ex.en: Why are you here so early, anyway?
ex.zh: 話說你到底為什麼這麼早來？

ex.en: Toyota Corporation announced that it would cut 1,000 positions this year.
ex.zh: 豐田公司宣布今年將裁員一千人。

ex.en: In the first place, I would like to announce several new regulations.
ex.zh: 首先，我想宣布幾項新規定。

ex.en: The engagement of Mr Rogers and Miss Smith was announced yesterday.
ex.zh: 羅傑斯先生和史密斯小姐昨天宣布訂婚。

ex.en: The pilot announced that we would land soon.
ex.zh: 機長廣播說我們即將降落。

ex.en: They announced the flight delay at the gate.
ex.zh: 他們在登機口廣播了班機延誤的消息。

ex.en: I don't know my father's annual income.
ex.zh: 我不知道我爸的年收入是多少。

ex.en: The annual meeting will be held in March.
ex.zh: 年度大會將於三月舉行。

ex.en: Our annual sales reached ten million dollars.
ex.zh: 我們的年銷售額達到一千萬元。

ex.en: The school publishes an annual every June.
ex.zh: 學校每年六月出版一本年刊。

ex.en: Her photo appeared in the company annual.
ex.zh: 她的照片登在公司年刊上。

ex.en: Is there anybody who can drive a car?
ex.zh: 有人會開車嗎？

ex.en: He promised me that he won't tell anybody.
ex.zh: 他答應我不會告訴任何人。

ex.en: She can sing better than anybody else in her class.
ex.zh: 她唱歌比班上任何人都好。

ex.en: The aviation expert analyzed the statistics in detail.
ex.zh: 航空專家詳細分析了統計資料。

ex.en: We want to analyze your urine.
ex.zh: 我們想化驗一下您的尿液。

ex.en: We need to analyze the sales data before the meeting.
ex.zh: 我們需要在開會前分析銷售資料。

ex.en: Did you go anywhere during the summer vacation?
ex.zh: 暑假你有去哪裡玩嗎？

ex.en: I didn't go anywhere on my time off.
ex.zh: 我休假時哪裡都沒去。

ex.en: They looked everywhere for him, but couldn't find him anywhere.
ex.zh: 他們到處找他，卻哪裡都找不到。

ex.en: You can sit anywhere you like.
ex.zh: 你想坐哪裡都可以。

ex.en: You can use this card anywhere in the world.
ex.zh: 這張卡在世界各地都能使用。

ex.en: You must be careful not to make him angry.
ex.zh: 你要小心別惹他生氣。

ex.en: I have no idea why she got so angry.
ex.zh: 我不知道她為什麼那麼生氣。

ex.en: When I forgot my promise, he got really angry.
ex.zh: 我忘了自己答應過的事，他非常生氣。

ex.en: From now on, I will not eat meat anymore.
ex.zh: 從現在起，我再也不吃肉了。

ex.en: He hurt his foot, he can't play soccer anymore.
ex.zh: 他腳受傷了，不能再踢足球了。

ex.en: Public morals are not respected anymore in this town.
ex.zh: 在這座城鎮，公共道德已經不再受到尊重。

ex.en: She threw off her shoes and socks in anger.
ex.zh: 她氣得把鞋子和襪子甩掉。

ex.en: She couldn't hide her anger.
ex.zh: 她掩飾不住自己的怒氣。

ex.en: His rude comments angered many customers.
ex.zh: 他無禮的言論激怒了許多顧客。

ex.en: The decision angered the staff.
ex.zh: 這個決定讓員工很不滿。

ex.en: Tom is a financial analyst.
ex.zh: 湯姆是一名財務分析師。

ex.en: Analysts expect sales to rise next quarter.
ex.zh: 分析師預期下一季銷售額會上升。

ex.en: She works as a data analyst at a bank.
ex.zh: 她在銀行擔任資料分析師。

ex.en: I anticipate that there will be trouble.
ex.zh: 我預料會有麻煩。

ex.en: We do not anticipate their buying a new car.
ex.zh: 我們預料他們不會買新車。

ex.en: We anticipate strong sales this quarter.
ex.zh: 我們預期這一季銷售會很強勁。

ex.en: I've been anticipating his arrival.
ex.zh: 我一直期待著他的到來。

ex.en: It is the most anticipated movie of the year.
ex.zh: 這是今年最受期待的電影。

ex.en: We should approach this problem from different angles.
ex.zh: 我們應該從不同角度看這個問題。

ex.en: Let's look at it from the customer's angle.
ex.zh: 我們從顧客的角度來看看。

ex.en: An angle of 90 degrees is called a right angle.
ex.zh: 90 度的角叫做直角。

ex.en: These two lines cut across each other at right angles.
ex.zh: 這兩條線以直角相交。

ex.en: A hexagon has six angles and six sides.
ex.zh: 六邊形有六個角和六條邊。

ex.en: He caused his parents a lot of anxiety.
ex.zh: 他讓父母非常擔心。

ex.en: The way to solve pre-exam anxiety is to start learning now.
ex.zh: 解決考前焦慮的方法就是現在開始讀書。

ex.en: Many people feel anxiety before a job interview.
ex.zh: 很多人在求職面試前會感到焦慮。

ex.en: The CEO will make an important announcement tomorrow.
ex.zh: 執行長明天將宣布一項重要消息。

ex.en: Please listen carefully to the announcement.
ex.zh: 請仔細聆聽廣播公告。

ex.en: The announcement was posted on the company website.
ex.zh: 公告已經貼在公司網站上。

ex.en: He was very anxious on the eve of the exam.
ex.zh: 考試前一晚，他非常焦慮。

ex.en: We are anxious about our daughter's health.
ex.zh: 我們很擔心女兒的健康。

ex.en: I'm very anxious about my son's safety.
ex.zh: 我很擔心兒子的安全。

ex.en: I am anxious to visit Britain once again.
ex.zh: 我很渴望再去一趟英國。

ex.en: He is anxious to know the result.
ex.zh: 他急著想知道結果。

ex.en: The teacher used an analogy to explain the idea.
ex.zh: 老師用一個比喻來解釋這個概念。

ex.en: He drew an analogy between the brain and a computer.
ex.zh: 他把大腦比作電腦。

ex.en: Many families honor their ancestors during Tomb Sweeping Day.
ex.zh: 很多家庭在清明節祭拜祖先。

ex.en: My ancestors came from Fujian.
ex.zh: 我的祖先來自福建。

ex.en: The vaccine helps your body produce antibodies.
ex.zh: 疫苗幫助身體產生抗體。

ex.en: The test checks for antibodies in your blood.
ex.zh: 這項檢測會檢查你血液中的抗體。

ex.en: This temple dates back to antiquity.
ex.zh: 這座廟可以追溯到古代。

ex.en: The great thinkers of antiquity still influence us.
ex.zh: 古代的偉大思想家至今仍影響著我們。

ex.en: The museum has a large collection of antiquities.
ex.zh: 博物館收藏了大量古文物。

ex.en: Exporting antiquities is strictly controlled.
ex.zh: 古物出口受到嚴格管制。

ex.en: The fund's annualized return was 6 percent.
ex.zh: 這檔基金的年化報酬率是百分之六。

ex.en: Analysts annualized the first-quarter sales figures.
ex.zh: 分析師把第一季的銷售數字換算成全年數字。

ex.en: The position offers a salary of 900,000 dollars per annum.
ex.zh: 這個職位年薪九十萬元。

ex.en: The loan carries an interest rate of 3 percent per annum.
ex.zh: 這筆貸款的年利率是百分之三。

ex.en: The fans waited in anticipation for the concert.
ex.zh: 歌迷們滿懷期待地等候演唱會。

ex.en: We hired more staff in anticipation of the holiday rush.
ex.zh: 我們預期連假會很忙，所以多聘了人手。

ex.en: Tom never forgets to give his wife flowers on their wedding anniversary.
ex.zh: 湯姆從不忘記在結婚紀念日送花給太太。

ex.en: Next month is their 50th anniversary, and they're planning on renewing their vows.
ex.zh: 下個月是他們結婚五十週年，他們打算重新宣誓。

ex.en: Anniversaries are important.
ex.zh: 週年紀念日很重要。

ex.en: The doctor prescribed antibiotics for my infection.
ex.zh: 醫生開了抗生素治療我的感染。

ex.en: Antibiotics don't work against viruses.
ex.zh: 抗生素對病毒無效。

ex.en: The family returned to their ancestral home every spring.
ex.zh: 這家人每年春天都回到祖宅。

ex.en: They visited the ancestral graves during the festival.
ex.zh: 他們在節日期間去祭拜祖先的墳墓。

ex.en: She has been a news anchor for twenty years.
ex.zh: 她當新聞主播已經二十年了。

ex.en: The anchor read the breaking news.
ex.zh: 主播播報了這則快訊。

ex.en: The ship dropped anchor near the island.
ex.zh: 船在島附近下錨。

ex.en: They pulled up the anchor and sailed away.
ex.zh: 他們拉起錨，揚帆而去。

ex.en: I wish I could see the ancient world.
ex.zh: 真希望我能看看古代世界。

ex.en: Ancient people liked to tell stories of bravery.
ex.zh: 古人喜歡講英勇的故事。

ex.en: The giant panda is a surviving ancient animal species.
ex.zh: 大熊貓是一種存活至今的古老物種。

ancient.zh: ancient history：（口語）早就過去的事

ex.en: "Tom and Mary have broken up." "That's ancient history."
ex.zh: 「湯姆和瑪麗分手了。」「那是老早以前的事了。」

ex.en: Don't worry about that argument. It's ancient history.
ex.zh: 別在意那次吵架了，那都是陳年往事了。

ex.en: I'm an anthropology research student, and my topic is 'Chinese medicine in Britain'.
ex.zh: 我是人類學研究生，研究題目是「中醫在英國」。

ex.en: Anthropology is the study of human societies and cultures.
ex.zh: 人類學是研究人類社會與文化的學問。

ex.en: The annual report is available on our website.
ex.zh: 年度報告已刊登在我們的網站上。

ex.en: Shareholders received the annual report in April.
ex.zh: 股東在四月收到了年報。

ex.en: The team uses analytics to understand buying habits.
ex.zh: 團隊運用分析工具了解購買習慣。

ex.en: Web analytics show where visitors leave the site.
ex.zh: 網站分析資料顯示訪客在哪個頁面離開。

ex.en: The procedure will be performed under local anesthesia.
ex.zh: 這項處置會在局部麻醉下進行。

ex.en: The anesthesiologist explained the risks of general anesthesia.
ex.zh: 麻醉科醫師說明了全身麻醉的風險。

ex.en: She persists in saying that her analysis is correct.
ex.zh: 她堅持認為自己的分析是正確的。

ex.en: We have to make a close analysis of the accident.
ex.zh: 我們必須仔細分析這起事故。

ex.en: It is difficult for me to answer the question.
ex.zh: 這個問題對我來講很難回答。

ex.en: You are not answering the question correctly.
ex.zh: 你答非所問。

ex.en: Nobody answered the phone.
ex.zh: 沒有人接電話。

ex.en: Can you answer the door? I'm busy.
ex.zh: 你可以去應門嗎？我在忙。

ex.en: After the exam we compared the answers we'd written.
ex.zh: 考試後，我們對了一下寫的答案。

ex.en: Excuse me for not having answered your letter sooner.
ex.zh: 這麼晚才回信，真不好意思。
